result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

© 2026 Coded Culinary | Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here's what's on the page:

**Blueberry Scones**
- **Yield:** 8 scones
- **Prep time:** 15 min
- **Bake time:** 20 min

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

**Tips:** For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

**Blueberry Scones Recipe**
- **Yield:** 8 scones
- **Prep time:** 15 minutes
- **Bake time:** 20 minutes

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.

5. Whisk cream, egg, and vanilla in a separate bowl, then stir into dry ingredients.
6. Shape dough into a 1-inch thick circle on a floured surface and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place on baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

**Tip:** Keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing for flaky scones. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze!

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

  • 1/2 tsp salt

  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

HomeRecipesAbout

Blueberry Scones

Published: 2025-09-15

These delicious blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or an afternoon treat. They are buttery, flaky, and loaded with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Let cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with a simple glaze.

Nutritional Information (per scone)

Calories280
Fat14g
Carbohydrates35g

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking!

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Coded Culinary

HomeRecipesAbout

Blueberry Scones

Published: 2025-09-15

These delicious blueberry scones are perfect for breakfast or an afternoon treat. They are buttery, flaky, and loaded with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  5. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Gently fold in blueberries.
  6. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Let cool slightly before serving. Optional: drizzle with a simple glaze.

Nutritional Information (per scone)

Fat14g
Carbohydrates35g

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking!

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.

5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

Ingredients

  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

execution_trajectory.agent_response:
I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐
